subject: Day-of family emergency — coverage plan, async option, and debrief instructions
messages:
From: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@gmail.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Interview today — urgent family matter

Hi Monica / Neha,

I'm really sorry for the abrupt note — I just had a family emergency come up (need to take my son to urgent care). I still want to move forward with the interview loop if possible, but I need some flexibility today. I'm available after 4:00 PM PT for live sessions, or happy to do an asynchronous coding exercise (48-hour turnaround) and a short phone check-in whenever it fits the team's schedule.

If rescheduling is easier, I'm free all day Friday and Monday morning. I apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your understanding.

Best,
Daniel
Daniel Cho
Senior Software Engineer (candidate)
Cell: (415) 555-0199
From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@gmail.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, ethan_park <ethan_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:58:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interview today — urgent family matter

Thanks for the heads up, Daniel — I hope everything is OK and please take the time you need. We can be flexible. Proposed options:

1) Team-run partial loop today: we hold the product + system-design interview at 11:00 AM PT (30m) with Laura, and move the backend coding/live exercise to an asynchronous take-home we send today (48-hour window). Panel holds a 30m debrief at 5:00 PM PT to consolidate notes.

2) Full reschedule: move the full loop to Friday morning (I can open 9:30–11:30 PT).

Monica — are you able to confirm Daniel's preference? Laura/Ethan — if we do option 1, can you commit to the shortened design slot at 11:00 and the 5pm debrief? If Ethan prefers to see more backend signal, we can ask Daniel to complete the take-home before the debrief.

I attached a brief debrief template and will update the calendar invites if we decide option 1. If anyone needs to swap out, please name a backup interviewer now.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Hiring Manager, Core Platform
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@gmail.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, ethan_park <ethan_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interview today — urgent family matter

Daniel — thanks for letting us know and I hope all goes well at urgent care. Daniel confirmed by phone a few minutes ago that he prefers option 1: do the shortened live design at 11:00 PT and take the backend exercise asynchronously today (48 hours). He asked for the exercise doc and clarified he can return it within the 48-hour window.

I've tentatively held the 11:00 slot and the 5:00 debrief on the calendar and added "updated-calendar-invite.ics" to the thread. I'll send the take-home (backend-coding-exercise.pdf) now.

Monica Patel
Recruiting (Tech) | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai
Attachment: backend-coding-exercise.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)
From: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.ai>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@gmail.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 10:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interview today — urgent family matter

Thanks for the quick coordination. I'm fine with the shortened design slot at 11:00 — let's cap it at 30 minutes and focus on high-level tradeoffs and one deep dive. Laura, could you cover product behavior and edge cases?

Action items for panel if we run option 1:
- Laura: product + behavioral (30m at 11:00)
- Ethan: system design narrower scope (30m) — I'll skip code pair today
- Panel: use the attached debrief template and submit consolidated feedback by 7:00 PM PT tonight so hiring committee can meet tomorrow.

If Daniel doesn't complete the take-home within 48 hours, we should treat it as incomplete and note it on the scorecard. Also, if candidate must cancel last-minute, we should convert all notes to an async written debrief and reschedule live follow-ups.

Ethan Park
Senior Staff Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.ai>, Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@gmail.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Final: Today’s plan + debrief logistics

Wrapping up plan for the record:
- 11:00–11:30 PT: Product + focused system-design (Laura + Ethan) — shortened to 30m
- Send take-home now: backend-coding-exercise.pdf (48-hour window)
- 17:00 PT: 30m panel debrief (virtual) — please come prepared with 3 bullet strengths, 3 concerns, and a numeric score (1–5) on the sheet. Use the attached panel-debrief-template.docx and drop consolidated notes in the Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QwxyzDebrief
- If Daniel cannot finish the take-home within 48 hours or needs more time due to the emergency, we will annotate that on the scorecard and decide on next steps (fast reschedule vs. extended window).

Monica — please update the calendar invites and include the updated description and the Meet link. Laura/Ethan — please add any immediate objections now; otherwise we'll proceed. Thanks everyone and Daniel — wishing your family a swift recovery.

Neha Kapoor
Hiring Manager, Core Platform
Redwood Inference
Attachment: panel-debrief-template.docx
